description: Springline meeting prep was produced without noting that Trinity Hunt Partners is also Improving's PE backer — making Springline a sister portfolio company in the same fund. This is a materially different relationship dynamic than a standard prospect and should have been surfaced in the brief.
correction: Trinity Hunt Partners is Improving's PE partner. Springline is a Trinity Hunt portfolio company. This is a sister portco relationship, not an arm's-length sales call. The brief should reflect this shared PE context and how it shapes the tone, trust level, and commercial dynamics of the conversation.
systemic_fix: Add Trinity Hunt / PE backer context to Improving's identity files so it is available to Chase on any engagement involving Trinity Hunt portfolio companies.
